author: docs/lead
content:
Assignment from docs/lead to docs/writer:

Please author and deliver two comprehensive, publication-grade documentation artifacts grounded 100% in ULTRON's AS-IMPLEMENTED pure Git-native architecture:

1. Project Root README.md (/Users/jvroig/Dev/ULTRON/README.md):
- Overwrite existing README.md. External engineers must immediately grasp:
  * What ULTRON (Universal Layered Team and Role Orchestration Network) and ULTRON PRIME (Ultimate Leader of Teams, Roles, and Operational Nodes) are and why they exist (high-autonomy multi-agent orchestration over agentic harnesses like Google Antigravity CLI/IDE and portable to Claude Code).
  * 5 Core architectural pillars:
    1. Single User-to-Prime point of contact + neutral workspace baseline (AGENTS.md neutral until explicit 'load ultron/core/ULTRON_PRIME.md').
    2. Sole lifecycle & provisioning authority on ULTRON PRIME (EnableSubagentTools=False on all Team Leads & Specialists; default Gemini Flash model conservation; dynamic wake/stand-down to save resources).
    3. Arbitrary N-layer Hive tree (ultron/hive/) with flat intra-team peer roles (lead is coordinator & external spokesperson, NOT elevated harness privileges; --read-only specialists).
    4. Pure Git-native zero-SQLite storage: team.json & role.json manifests in ultron/hive/, gitignored ephemeral .runtime/sessions.json (zero git status noise on wake/sleep), and append-only JSONL threads (ultron/core/threads/*.jsonl) with conflict-free cross-branch merges via '*.jsonl merge=union'.
    5. Three-tier visibility scoping (personal, team + --with-team cross-layer handoffs, global) + Reactive Doorbell protocol (whois --id-only + send_message, zero polling).
  * Repository layout, Quickstart (booting ULTRON PRIME, spawning & standing down a team, running tests), and links to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, ultron/core/README.md, and ultron-architecture.html.

2. Deep-Dive Technical Architecture Doc at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (/Users/jvroig/Dev/ULTRON/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
- Cover complete technical specification as implemented:
  * System topology & trust/privilege model (ULTRON PRIME vs Team Leads vs Specialists, read-only role guardrails vs Antigravity EnableWriteTools/run_command nuance).
  * On-disk data model & schemas: exact fields of team.json, role.json, .runtime/sessions.json, and all 4 append-only JSONL event types ('thread', 'post', 'status', 'reclassify') + deterministic (created_at, event_id) folding under Git merge=union.
  * Concurrency & atomicity (POSIX fcntl.flock shared/exclusive locking, atomic temp-file + fsync + os.replace, O_APPEND JSONL fsync).
  * Lifecycle state machine & safety invariants (activate-team parent/lead/partial/allow-detached guards, prepare-disable + manage_subagents kill + disable-team cascade, stale ghost-session purging across branch checkouts, verify --prune-orphans).
  * Visibility & authorization matrix (personal survival across respawns, intra-team & --with-team parent/child routing, global, reclassify permissions) + Reactive Doorbell sequence diagram (Mermaid).

Reference files to inspect:
- ultron/core/core.py
- ultron/core/ULTRON_PRIME.md
- ultron/core/README.md
- ultron/core/templates/*.tmpl
- ultron/core/threads/.gitattributes
- ultron/core/.gitignore
- AGENTS.md
- tests/test_ultron_core.py

Rules:
- Ground every claim strictly in the codebase.
- Do NOT run git commit or git push.
- When finished, reply to this thread with a summary and doorbell docs/lead.
